segments.sn11.20:1.3: “bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, sakko devānamindo mātaliṃ saṅgāhakaṃ āmantesi –
segments.sn11.20:1.4: ‘yojehi, samma mātali, sahassayuttaṃ ājaññarathaṃ, uyyānabhūmiṃ gacchāma subhūmiṃ dassanāyā’ti.
segments.sn11.20:1.5: ‘Evaṃ bhaddantavā’ti kho, bhikkhave, mātali saṅgāhako sakkassa devānamindassa paṭissutvā, sahassayuttaṃ ājaññarathaṃ yojetvā sakkassa devānamindassa paṭivedesi –
segments.sn11.20:1.6: ‘yutto kho te, mārisa, sahassayutto ājaññaratho, yassa dāni kālaṃ maññasī’”ti.
segments.sn11.20:1.8: Atha kho, bhikkhave, sakko devānamindo vejayantapāsādā orohanto añjaliṃ katvā sudaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ namassati.
segments.sn11.20:1.9: Atha kho, bhikkhave, mātali saṅgāhako sakkaṃ devānamindaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi –
segments.sn11.20:3.3: Ācāraṃ isinaṃ brūhi, taṃ suṇoma vaco tavā”ti.
segments.sn11.20:4.3: Yamhā gāmā pakkamanti, anapekkhā vajanti te.
segments.sn11.20:5.1: “Na tesaṃ koṭṭhe openti, na kumbhi [na kumbhā (syā. kaṃ. pī. ka.)] na kaḷopiyaṃ [khaḷopiyaṃ (sī.)];
segments.sn11.20:5.3: Paraniṭṭhitamesānā [paraniṭṭhitamesanā (syā. kaṃ. ka.)], tena yāpenti subbatā.
segments.sn11.20:6.3: Devā viruddhā asurehi, puthu maccā ca mātali.
segments.sn11.20:8.1: “Seṭṭhā hi kira lokasmiṃ, ye tvaṃ sakka namassasi;
segments.sn11.20:8.3: Ahampi te namassāmi, ye namassasi vāsavā”ti.
segments.sn11.20:10.1: Devā pana [va tapadena (sī. syā. kaṃ.)] tayo vuttā, daliddañca rāmaṇeyyakaṃ;

lines: Dasame ajjhabhāsīti kasmā esa punappunaṃ evaṃ bhāsatīti?
Sakkassa kira devarañño saddo madhuro, suphasitaṃ dantāvaraṇaṃ, kathanakāle suvaṇṇakiṅkiṇikasaddo viya niccharati.
Pūtidehasayāti pūtimhi mātusarīre vā, attanoyeva vā sarīraṃ avattharitvā sayanato pūtidehasayā.
Nimuggā kuṇapamheteti dasamāse mātukucchisaṅkhāte kuṇapasmiṃ ete nimuggā.
Etaṃ tesaṃ pihayāmīti etesaṃ etaṃ pihayāmi patthayāmi.
Na te saṃ koṭṭhe opentīti na te saṃ santakaṃ dhaññaṃ koṭṭhe pakkhipanti.
Paraniṭṭhitamesānāti paresaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ paraghare pakkaṃ bhikkhācāravattena esamānā gavesamānā.
Sumantamantinoti dhammaṃ sajjhāyissāma, dhutaṅgaṃ samādiyissāma, amataṃ paribhuñjissāma, samaṇadhammaṃ karissāmāti evaṃ subhāsitabhāsino.
Tuṇhībhūtā samañcarāti tiyāmarattiṃ asanighosena ghositā viya dhammaṃ kathentāpi tuṇhībhūtā samaṃ carantiyeva nāma.
Attadaṇḍesu nibbutāti paraviheṭhanatthaṃ gahitadaṇḍesu sattesu nibbutā vissaṭṭhadaṇḍā.
Sādānesu anādānāti sagahaṇesu sattesu ca bhavayoniādīnaṃ ekakoṭṭhāsassāpi agahitattā agahaṇā.
Pūtimhi dehe mātu sarīre sayanato, attano eva vā pūtidehaṃ sarīraṃ tasmiṃ ṭhitatāya avattharitvā sayanato pūtidehasayāti yojanā.
Kuṇapamheteti ete manussā asuciduggandhajegucchapaṭikkūle mātukucchisaṅkhāte kuṇapasmiṃ dasa māse nimuggā.
Etesaṃ etaṃ vihayāmīti etesaṃ isīnaṃ etaṃ sammāpaṭipattiṃ vihayāmi.
Idāni taṃ paṭipattiṃ dassetuṃ “na te saṃ koṭṭhe opentī”ti vuttaṃ.
Dhaññaṃ koṭṭhe na pakkhipanti pakkhipitabbassa ca abhāvato.
Paresaṃ niṭṭhitanti paresaṃ gahitaṃ santakaṃ tesaṃ pākāya niṭṭhitaṃ.
